band.label: Accounting export status and actions
band.mappingHeld: Comes with W2b, in Finance settings.

layout.long: Files in Nexus's default layout: the accountant's software and its import layout are to confirm with the accountant. Nothing is sent to the accountant or to any authority: a person hands the files over.

notice.cancelled: The draft export of {month} is cancelled.

live.fixed_one: {count} check fixed since you opened this
live.fixed_other: {count} checks fixed since you opened this
live.changed: The month changed since you opened this

noAccess.title: You cannot see the accounting exports
noAccess.body: They need the accounting permission (accounting.view). Ask an administrator.

SALES_JOURNAL.title: Sales journal
SALES_JOURNAL.body: The invoices issued in the month, one row per VAT rate (an invoice rejected by SDI counts as never issued).

PURCHASES_JOURNAL.title: Purchases journal
PURCHASES_JOURNAL.body: The supplier invoices received in the month (by the day they arrived), one row per VAT rate.

PAYMENTS.title: Payments
PAYMENTS.body: The payments received in the month, what each pays and what is not placed; the refunds paid in the month.

COST_OF_SALES.title: Cost of goods sold and variances
COST_OF_SALES.body: What the goods sold cost, and the work orders' variances.

VAT_REGISTERS.title: VAT registers
VAT_REGISTERS.body: The VAT registers of the month.

INTRASTAT.title: Intrastat (EU sales)
INTRASTAT.body: The month's sales of goods to other EU states, with the data the file needs.

YEAR_END_STOCK.title: Year-end stock pack
YEAR_END_STOCK.body: The signed-off year-end inventory (its valued list as signed) and the stock valued at the year end.

held.w2b: Comes with W2b: it cannot go in an export yet.
held.yearEnd: Goes with the export of the month that ends the year (31 December).

grain.price: It carries prices: it needs the price grain (money.price).
grain.cost: It carries costs: it needs the cost grain (money.cost).

contents.reDocuments_one: Re-export: {count} document new, changed or removed goes.
contents.reDocuments_other: Re-export: {count} documents new, changed or removed go.
contents.reWhole_one: Re-export: the whole file again ({count} change behind it).
contents.reWhole_other: Re-export: the whole file again ({count} changes behind it).
contents.intrastatAccountant: Whether the company files Intrastat, how often and in which file is to confirm with the accountant.

history.title: Exports
history.lead: Every batch, numbered; a re-export carries only what changed, never a duplicate.

empty.title: No exports yet
empty.body: Make the first numbered batch for the accountant with New export.

noMatch.title: No batch matches
noMatch.body: No batch has this status in this year.

held.notExported: Only an exported batch is re-exported.
held.notLatest: A later batch ({number}) carries the month now: re-export that one.
held.nothingChanged: Nothing changed since {number}: there is nothing to re-export.
held.notDraft: Only a draft is cancelled; an exported batch is amended by a re-export.

unselectable.draft: A draft has no files yet.
unselectable.cancelled: A cancelled batch has no files.

cancel.title: Cancel the draft export of {month}?
cancel.body: The draft never got its number and its files were never handed over. The next export of the month replaces it anyway.

period.title: Period
period.lead: Which month goes to the accountant, and whether it is locked.

checks.title: Checks
checks.lead: Each check passes, or is explained in words before the export (the batch keeps the explanation).

contents.title: Contents
contents.lead: What goes to the accountant in this batch.

intrastat.title: Intrastat rows
intrastat.lead: The EU sales rows with the data the file needs; what is missing is flagged with where to fix it.

held.reading: Wait until the month is read.
held.readFailed: The month could not be read: try again.
held.intrastat: Fix the rows that lack data, or explain the Intrastat check.
held.nothingChanged: Nothing changed since {number}: there is nothing to send.
held.noExport: Making a batch needs the export permission (accounting.export).
held.busy: Wait: the last action is still running.

period.noNextYear: The next year has not begun.
period.first: {month} is not exported yet: this batch is its first export.
period.reExport_one: {month} is exported as {number}: this batch is a re-export of what changed since ({count} document).
period.reExport_other: {month} is exported as {number}: this batch is a re-export of what changed since ({count} documents).
period.running: The month is not over (it ends on {end}): what is dated later reaches the accountant in a re-export.
period.draft: A draft of this month did not finish: this export replaces it.
period.yearEnd: The month ends the year: the year-end stock pack goes with it.

PERIOD_ENDED.title: The month is over
PERIOD_ENDED.fail_one: {month} is not over (it ends on {end}): what is dated later goes in a re-export.
PERIOD_ENDED.fail_other: {month} is not over (it ends on {end}): what is dated later goes in a re-export.

SHIPMENTS_INVOICED.title: Every shipment invoiced
SHIPMENTS_INVOICED.pass: Every DDT of goods shipped in {month} is invoiced.
SHIPMENTS_INVOICED.fail_one: {count} DDT of goods shipped in {month} is not wholly invoiced.
SHIPMENTS_INVOICED.fail_other: {count} DDTs of goods shipped in {month} are not wholly invoiced.

NO_INVOICE_REJECTED.title: No invoice rejected at SDI
NO_INVOICE_REJECTED.pass: No invoice of {month} is rejected by SDI.
NO_INVOICE_REJECTED.fail_one: {count} invoice of {month} is rejected by SDI: it counts as never issued until it is sent again.
NO_INVOICE_REJECTED.fail_other: {count} invoices of {month} are rejected by SDI: they count as never issued until they are sent again.

PAYMENTS_PLACED.title: Payments placed
PAYMENTS_PLACED.pass: Every payment received in {month} is placed on what it pays.
PAYMENTS_PLACED.fail_one: {count} payment received in {month} is not wholly placed on what it pays.
PAYMENTS_PLACED.fail_other: {count} payments received in {month} are not wholly placed on what they pay.

PLACEMENTS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.title: Placements never exceed payments
PLACEMENTS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.pass: No payment is placed or refunded beyond its amount.
PLACEMENTS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.fail_one: {count} payment is placed or refunded beyond its amount.
PLACEMENTS_WITHIN_PAYMENTS.fail_other: {count} payments are placed or refunded beyond their amount.

TOTALS_EQUAL_ROWS.title: Totals equal row sums
TOTALS_EQUAL_ROWS.pass: Every invoice's totals equal the sum of its VAT rows.
TOTALS_EQUAL_ROWS.fail_one: {count} invoice has totals that are not the sum of its VAT rows.
TOTALS_EQUAL_ROWS.fail_other: {count} invoices have totals that are not the sum of their VAT rows.

INTRASTAT_COMPLETE.title: Intrastat data complete
INTRASTAT_COMPLETE.pass: Every EU sale row has what the Intrastat file needs.
INTRASTAT_COMPLETE.fail_one: {count} item of data the Intrastat file needs is missing (see Intrastat rows).
INTRASTAT_COMPLETE.fail_other: {count} items of data the Intrastat file needs are missing (see Intrastat rows).

YEAR_END_SIGNED_OFF.title: Year-end inventory signed off
YEAR_END_SIGNED_OFF.pass: Every site's year-end inventory is signed off.
YEAR_END_SIGNED_OFF.fail_one: {count} year-end inventory is open or missing.
YEAR_END_SIGNED_OFF.fail_other: {count} year-end inventories are open or missing.

STOCK_VALUED.title: Every stock move valued
STOCK_VALUED.pass: Every stock move up to the year end has its value.
STOCK_VALUED.fail_one: {count} stock move up to the year end has no value yet.
STOCK_VALUED.fail_other: {count} stock moves up to the year end have no value yet.

check.explain: Why it may pass over (kept with the batch)
check.explainHint: In words the accountant reads: what is open and when it closes.

intrastat.accountant: To confirm with the accountant: whether the company files Intrastat for sales, monthly or quarterly, the official file and the nature codes (11 and 21 are only suggested).

empty.title: No EU sales in {month}
empty.body: No goods of the month went to another EU state: the Intrastat file would be empty.

review.first: Everything in the chosen packages goes: this is the month's first batch.
review.reExport: A re-export of {number}: journals carry only their new, changed and removed documents; Intrastat and the year-end pack go whole again when anything behind them changed.
review.changedHint: Different from what the accountant holds
review.grains: Sums of a grain you do not hold are not shown.

export.noSeries: No number series yet (Admin › Documents & numbering)
export.willMake: The files this batch will make
export.fileYearEnd_one: CSV · {count} row, with the signed-off valued list (PDF, XLSX)
export.fileYearEnd_other: CSV · {count} rows, with the signed-off valued list (PDF, XLSX)
export.languageHint: Headings and number format (Italian: ; and the decimal comma).
export.handOver: Exporting makes the files and gives the batch its number. Nothing is sent: you hand the files to the accountant.
export.makingDetail: The month is read again, the files are made, then the number is given.
export.doneBody: Download the files and hand them to the accountant; then lock the month.
export.openFiles: Open the files in a new tab
export.nothingBody: There is no batch to make: the accountant holds the month as it is. You can lock it.

none.title: No batch named
none.body: Open the files from Finance › Accounting export.

files.explained: Checks passed over, with their explanation
files.allPassed_one: {count} check passed when it was made.
files.allPassed_other: All {count} checks passed when it was made.

lock.title: Lock {month}
lock.lead: Lock the month once its batch is handed over: soft (finance may still write into it with a reason) or hard (nothing dated in it can change).
lock.afterExport: The lock comes after the batch is made.
lock.accountant: Agree the final close with the accountant first.

now.hard: {month} is closed for good by {by} since {at}.
now.lifted: {month}: its lock was lifted by {by} on {at}.

short.soft: {month} is soft-locked: finance may still write into it with a reason.
short.hard: {month} is closed for good: nothing dated in it can change.
short.lifted: {month} was locked, and its lock was lifted.

soft.title: Soft lock
soft.body: Finance may still write into the month, with a reason.
soft.already: The month is soft-locked already: choose Hard to close it for good.

hard.title: Hard lock (final close)
hard.body: Nothing dated in {month} can change: the database refuses it. Only the owner lifts it, with a reason.

phrase.label: Type "{phrase}" to close it for good
phrase.empty: Type the phrase exactly; capitals and extra spaces do not count.

done.hardBody: Nothing dated in the month can change now.

held.alreadyHard: The month is closed for good already.
held.hardFirst: A closed month is lifted first, never made soft.

lift.title: Lift the lock
lift.softBody: Writes dated in the month are open again (accounting.lock).
lift.hardBody: Only someone who may lift a final close (accounting.unlock: the owner) does it, with a fresh code from the authenticator app. Agree it with the accountant first.

held.noUnlock: Lifting a final close needs accounting.unlock (the owner, by default).

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.lift: Lifting a final close asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.

read.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
read.forbidden: You may not see this company's accounting.
read.not_found: This batch or month no longer exists.
read.unavailable: The factory system did not answer: try again.
read.rate_limited: Too many reads at once: wait a moment.
read.invalid: The month or a filter is not valid.
read.internal: Something went wrong on our side.

write.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again, then try once more.
write.forbidden: You may not do this (a permission or a grain is missing).
write.not_found: This batch or lock no longer exists: the page is read again.
write.rate_limited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
write.unavailable: The factory system did not answer: nothing was done, try again.
write.step_up: A fresh code from your authenticator app is needed.
write.internal: Something went wrong on our side: nothing was done.
write.explain: A failing check is not explained yet: explain it on the Checks step.
write.phrase: The phrase is not the one asked.
write.moved: Someone changed it meanwhile: it is read again.
write.changedWhile: Documents of the month changed while the export was being made: the month is read again; export it again.

refusal.ALREADY_EXPORTED: The month is exported already: the next batch is a re-export of what changed (the month is read again).
refusal.EXPORTED_MEANWHILE: Someone exported the month meanwhile: look at it again.
refusal.NOTHING_CHANGED: Nothing changed since the last batch: there is nothing to send.
refusal.NOT_LATEST: A later batch carries the month now: the month is read again.
refusal.NOTHING_EXPORTED: The month has no exported batch to amend: the month is read again.
refusal.PACKAGE_W2B: A chosen package comes with W2b.
refusal.YEAR_END_NOT_THIS_PERIOD: The year-end stock pack goes only with the month that ends the year.
refusal.PACKAGE_GRAIN: A chosen package carries amounts of a grain you do not hold.
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: This batch is not a draft any more: the list is read again.
refusal.CANCELLED: This export was replaced or cancelled before it finished: look at the month again.
refusal.ALREADY_LOCKED: The month is locked so already.
refusal.HARD_LOCKED: The month is closed for good: lift the lock first.
refusal.OVERLAPS: Another lock covers this month already.
refusal.CHANGED: The lock changed meanwhile: it is read again.
refusal.INVOICE_REJECTED: An invoice of the month is rejected by SDI: send it again first.
refusal.STOCK_NOT_VALUED: Some stock moves of the month have no value yet.
refusal.YEAR_END_COUNT_OPEN: A year-end inventory is still open.
refusal.YEAR_END_COUNT_MISSING: The year-end inventory of December is not applied yet.
refusal.other: Something still holds the final close.
